# FUNAS Insulations

> FUNAS is a professional thermal insulation materials manufacturer in China offering high-performance products including rubber foam, glass wool, rock wool, and polyurethane foam for HVAC, automotive, construction, and industrial applications.

FUNAS specializes in wholesale thermal insulation materials with comprehensive product solutions, industry-specific applications, and a portfolio of completed projects. The company combines quality manufacturing with sustainable practices to serve diverse sectors including construction, HVAC systems, automotive, and real estate development.

## Core Products

- [Rubber Foam Thermal Insulation Material](https://www.funasinsulations.com/rubber-foam.html): High-quality rubber foam product: thermal insulation and soundproofing material for multiple applications.
- [Glass Wool for Insulation](https://www.funasinsulations.com/glass-wool.html): Wholesale glass wool insulation material for energy efficiency and thermal protection.
- [Rock Wool for Insulation](https://www.funasinsulations.com/rock-wool.html): Thermal insulation with noise reduction and durability properties for construction and industrial use.
- [Polyurethane Foam](https://www.funasinsulations.com/polyurethane-foam.html): Versatile insulation and cushioning material for multiple applications across industries.
- [Adhesive Products](https://www.funasinsulations.com/adhesive.html): Industrial and insulation adhesives for construction applications and material installation.

## Industry Solutions

- [HVAC Insulation Solutions](https://www.funasinsulations.com/hvac.html): High-performance thermal insulation materials for HVAC systems and energy efficiency.

- [Construction Engineering Solutions](https://www.funasinsulations.com/construction-engineering.html): Thermal insulation solutions for building projects and construction applications.
